sfx_hop_charge.prompt: A short, rising pitch sound effect for a cartoon game, 1.5 seconds long. It sounds like a spring being compressed or a tension-building synthesized slide. The pitch starts low and glides upward smoothly to represent a power meter filling. Light, whimsical, and non-threatening.

sfx_hop_release.prompt: A quick, energetic 'boing' and 'whoosh' sound effect combined. A satisfying spring release sound for a cartoon character jumping. Sharp attack, very short decay, conveying upward and forward momentum. Clean and snappy.
sfx_hop_release.description: Quick whoosh/spring release sound for when the player launches the sack hop.

sfx_landing_good.prompt: A solid but muffled 'thud' sound effect on a dirt surface. It has a slight fabric rustle or burlap sack texture to the impact. Cartoony squash-and-stretch feel, satisfying and short, representing a successful landing in a sack race.

sfx_landing_tumble.prompt: Comedic slapstick tumbling sound effect. A series of 3-4 rapid, soft 'oomph' and 'thud' sounds with a rolling burlap texture. Evokes a character clumsily rolling inside a sack on a dirt path. Lighthearted and funny.
sfx_landing_tumble.description: Comedic rolling and bouncing sound effect for when a character loses balance and falls.

sfx_recovery.prompt: A quick, upbeat 'pop' or 'blip' sound effect. Sounds like a spring-loaded character snapping back to an upright position. Bright, high-frequency, and resilient. Very short duration with a clean tail.
sfx_recovery.description: Quick pop/spring sound for character getting back up after a tumble.

sfx_crowd_cheer.prompt: Excited crowd ambiance for an outdoor festival. Sounds of a group of Indonesian people (men, women, and children) cheering, clapping hands, and shouting joyful encouragement. Not a stadium crowd, but a more intimate village street vibe. Natural, festive, and loopable.
sfx_crowd_cheer.description: Ambient sound of a festive Indonesian village crowd cheering and clapping.

sfx_finish_celebration.prompt: A triumphant victory sound effect for a finish line. Features a sudden surge in crowd cheering, a celebratory whistle, and a bright Gamelan or Angklung musical flourish. Joyful, festive Indonesian Independence Day celebration vibe.
sfx_finish_celebration.description: Triumphant victory fanfare with crowd surge and traditional accents.

music_race_theme.prompt: Upbeat and energetic Indonesian fusion track for a racing game. 130 BPM. music_menu_theme.prompt: Cheerful and relaxed Indonesian village festival atmosphere music. 105 BPM. Gentle percussion, soft Suling flute or melodic Angklung, and warm acoustic textures. sfx_mud_splash.prompt: A wet, squelchy mud splash sound effect. Thick, liquid impact with a comical 'splat' sound. No background noise, clean and punchy for gameplay feedback.
sfx_mud_splash.description: A wet, squelchy splash sound effect for landing in mud, designed with a comedic tone.

sfx_slip_slide.prompt: A classic comedic cartoon slide whistle sound, starting with a quick high-to-low pitch drop followed by a wobbling high-pitched finish. It should sound rubbery and friction-based, representing a character losing their footing on slippery moss. Bright, whimsical, and exaggerated for a festive village atmosphere. High-fidelity, clean recording with no background noise.
sfx_slip_slide.description: Comedic cartoon slide whistle sound for a character slipping on mossy surfaces.

sfx_rock_impact.prompt: A sharp, comedic cartoon 'clonk' or hollow 'thud' sound effect. Imagine a wooden or stone impact against a soft object. It should have a snappy attack, a slightly resonant wooden quality, and a very short decay. No metal sounds, no realistic bone breaking. Designed for a character tripping and losing balance in a lighthearted, playful sack race game. Clean and isolated for frequent in-game use.
sfx_rock_impact.description: A sharp, comedic 'clonk' sound effect for tripping over a rock, consistent with the game's cartoonish Indonesian festival style.
